About.title: The part nobody sees, and everyone relies on.
About.bio: I’m Faxriddin, a backend engineer from Tashkent. Since 2024 I’ve shipped 20+ projects: freelancing, working remotely with international companies and building backends for startups. Today my focus is AI agents — systems that read, decide and act inside a business through LLMs, RAG and MCP tools. I build them on solid Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL foundations. Alongside the work, I study Software Engineering at PDP University.
